tools.name: records_query
tools.description: Read the agent's own additional tables using one SQL statement. The tables and their meanings are in the installed checkout's records/README.md. information_schema is available. Pass a row cap; the result says if more rows were present. This tool cannot write.

sql.description: one SELECT or other read-only SQL statement; no second statement

max_rows.description: maximum number of rows to return, from 1 to 1000

returns.what: the requested rows and whether the cap hid more

fields.name: rows
fields.what: rows returned by the read statement

fields.name: truncated
fields.what: true if more rows existed beyond max_rows

tools.name: records_write
tools.description: Insert or update the agent's own additional tables with one SQL statement. Pass the current message id or stable timer event id as source_message_id, and the maximum rows this operation may change. The database refuses deletes, truncation, protected tables and DDL. The returned change records show what actually committed.

sql.description: one INSERT or UPDATE statement, including a WITH statement

source_message_id.description: the current message id or stable timer event id that caused this change

max_rows.description: maximum changed rows to commit, from 1 to 1000

fields.name: changes
fields.what: old and new rows with cause ids

tools.name: job_open
tools.description: Open one run of an installed SOP. Name its SOP, the conversation or work unit, the client references, and the current message or timer event id. The cause id is required for the change log and is a trace supplied by you, not verified authority. Read the new job before taking an action.

unit.description: conversation or work unit this job belongs to

references.description: client reference identifiers, or [] when none exists yet

source_message_id.description: current message id or stable timer event id; never blank or guessed

returns.what: the new job's position and waits

fields.name: positions
fields.what: current positions with meaning and instructions

tools.name: job_find
tools.description: Find jobs that name one client reference. Use this before opening a second job for the same client work. The result may contain several jobs; inspect each before acting.

tools.name: job_read
tools.description: Read a job's installed SOP version, current positions, instructions, waits, pending actions and legal intended steps. A pending action after a restart requires reading the client system before retrying it.

job.description: job UUID returned by job_open or job_find

fields.name: waits
fields.what: open waits with owner and since

tools.name: job_check
tools.description: Ask whether one intended SOP step is legal from this job's current positions. This answer helps you choose, but the action tool checks again under a lock before any external effect.

fields.name: allowed
fields.what: whether this step is legal now

tools.name: job_record
tools.description: Record one SOP step. An intent must be legal and becomes pending without moving a position. A collected observation moves the position even when the SOP did not predict it, and is flagged off_model then. An agent-action observation needs a trusted action-tool receipt; your claim alone cannot advance it.

kind.description: intent before action, or observation after collected fact

source_id.description: message, client check or action receipt id that caused the step

returns.what: the recorded step or named refusal

fields.name: off_model
fields.what: whether a collected fact did not follow a declared path

fields.name: pending
fields.what: the pending action after an intent
